notes.subject: ⟨a⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew פיהו 'his mouth' carries the possessor; the bracketed pronoun marks whose mouth

notes.subject: kanuyaw
notes.rationale: דודיך plural: 'loves/love-tokena' — rendered 'kanuya' (love); lost is the plural of endearments

notes.subject: kumasen in kɔnɔ
notes.rationale: the woman speaks, addressing the beloved directly as 'i'

notes.subject: a bisi ne
notes.rationale: opening wish addressed to the beloved, drawing the hearer in

translation: A bisi ne ni ⟨a⟩ da bisikenw ye, sabu i kanuyaw ka gɛn diwɛn ye.
